name: Jellyfin media
description: Search your own Jellyfin library and play music, movies and shows on one of its players (a TV app, a phone, a browser tab): pause, skip, stop, volume, what is playing, and music playlists. It needs your Jellyfin address on your home network and a Jellyfin API key. It does not play on this computer's own speakers, and it does not handle books, favorites, radio or library scans.
author: Cypher Sisters

tools.set_address: Save the address of your Jellyfin server on your home network, like http://192.168.1.20:8096. For an address off this computer, the bot raises a Yes card for that address and port.
tools.search_media: Search your Jellyfin library for songs, albums, artists, movies or shows by words, with item ids.
tools.list_players: List the Jellyfin players that can be controlled: client, device, user and what each is playing.
tools.play: Play a song, album, playlist, movie or show from your Jellyfin library on one of its players.
tools.control: Pause, unpause, stop, skip to next or previous, or set the volume on a Jellyfin player.
tools.now_playing: Say what each Jellyfin player is playing now.
tools.create_playlist: Make a new Jellyfin music playlist, optionally with songs found by name.
tools.add_to_playlist: Add songs, found by name, to one of your Jellyfin playlists.

keys.name: JELLYFIN_API_KEY
keys.why: to search your library and play on your players
keys.get_it: In Jellyfin open Dashboard, API Keys, and add one

setup_steps.title: Tell the bot where your Jellyfin is
setup_steps.why: Jellyfin media talks only to the Jellyfin you name, on your home network. Jellyfin's usual address is http://<the computer running Jellyfin>:8096. In chat, say: set my Jellyfin address to http://192.168.1.20:8096 (with your own address). Then the bot raises a Yes card for that address and port, and the owner can also allow one herself on the Bridge page.

consent: Jellyfin media talks only to the Jellyfin server at the address you set on your home network, with your own Jellyfin API key, to search your library, start and control playback and make playlists. It keeps nothing but that address, in its own data folder on this computer, and it does not use the internet.
